text: {"assertions":["A cache miss storm issue was identified on 2026-01-12 in build/bazel/BUILD.bazel where targets that should have been cached were being rebuilt.","The cache miss storm could be reproduced by building twice without any source code changes.","The cache miss storm only occurred for tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys.","Connection pool exhaustion under burst load was identified as the root cause of the cache miss storm.","The fix involved raising the connection pool ceiling and adding a bounded wait queue, implemented in PR #3668 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-1.","The cache miss storm fix resulted in reclaiming 99 GB of blob storage.","The build system uses Starlark, with remote cache hit rate checks in CI serving as the verification mechanism."]}
